matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the incorrect statement of Proposition 1's closed-form formula in the main text (showing a normalized weighted average when it should be a simple weighted sum). The findings flag errors in Equation (5) (pred_id 1) and Appendix A.1 equations 27-29 (pred_id 2), but neither identifies the specific defect in Proposition 1's statement itself. Pred_id 2 discusses a derivation error in the appendix proof, not the inconsistency in how Proposition 1 is stated in the main text.

GT2 concerns the incorrect claim that the Monte Carlo estimator is unbiased (when it should be acknowledged as biased). None of the three findings address this issue; they all focus on algebraic errors in specific equations rather than the theoretical claim about bias/unbiasedness of the estimator in Proposition 2.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Reports an algebraic error in Equation (5) regarding the conditional flow matching target, which is not among the ground truth defects.
Reports a missing factor of 1/n in the derivation in Appendix A.1, which is not among the ground truth defects.
Reports a missing factor of n in the variance proof in Appendix B.3, which is not among the ground truth defects.
